description: Land Title Settlement Department - Wariyapola, Wariyapola D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420946 and Others
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, cadastral maps, locations, and ownership details) in various villages in the Kurunegala District. The content focuses on land ownership, title settlements, and property registration, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
